items.title: Resolving carbon partitioning between organic biomass and calcite in Gephyrocapsa huxleyi using online gas monitoring and phase-resolved mass balances.
items.hook: The study used online gas monitoring and phase-resolved mass balances to resolve how the coccolithophore Gephyrocapsa huxleyi partitions carbon between organic biomass and calcite.

items.title: Early assessment of cyanobacteria growth in water reservoirs from high-frequency multispectral active fluorescence.
items.hook: Multispectral active fluorometry was applied to detect early cyanobacteria growth in water reservoirs, enabling early warning of blooms.

items.title: Dietary supplementation with Spirulina platensis and humic acid alleviates heat stress in broiler chickens: effects on growth performance, serum metabolites, immune responses, and antioxidant capacity.
items.hook: Dietary supplementation with Spirulina platensis and humic acid improves broiler chicken growth, immune responses, and antioxidant capacity under heat stress.

items.title: Dietary protein sources shape the digestive-tract microbiota of white shrimp (Penaeus vannamei): differences among digestive organs.
items.hook: Alternative protein sources alter the digestive‑tract microbiota of white shrimp, with distinct effects across digestive organs.

items.title: Energy and carbon reallocation underlie the growth-storage trade-off in Haematococcus lacustris.
items.hook: Showed that Haematococcus lacustris reallocates energy and carbon between growth and storage during the growth‑storage trade‑off.

items.title: Contrasting pH-mediated inhibitory effects of ammonium chloride and urea on Tetradesmus obliquus: Insights from physiology, transcriptomics, and targeted amino acid metabolomics.
items.hook: Demonstrated that ammonium chloride and urea inhibit Tetradesmus obliquus growth via pH‑mediated effects, supported by physiology, transcriptomics, and metabolomics.

items.title: Exploring ERF transcription factors from Haematococcus pluvialis and their regulatory function in carotenoids metabolism.
items.hook: Explores ERF transcription factors in Haematococcus pluvialis and their regulatory role in carotenoid metabolism.

items.title: High-throughput solvent screening for microalgae oil extraction based on multi-criteria decision analysis.
items.hook: Develops a high‑throughput solvent screening approach for microalgae oil extraction based on multi‑criteria decision analysis.

items.title: CRISPR/Cas for diatom gene editing: pitfalls, solutions, and emerging tools.
items.hook: Reviews pitfalls and solutions for CRISPR/Cas gene editing in diatoms, highlighting emerging tools for functional genomics.

items.title: 3D focused impedance spectroscopy for label-free profiling of thermal stress in microalgae.
items.hook: Introduces 3D focused impedance spectroscopy for rapid, label‑free profiling of thermal stress in microalgae cultures.
